description: This file defines the NodeRevisionDeleteForm class, which provides a form for deleting a specific node revision in Drupal. It includes methods for form creation, rendering, and submission handling, including revision deletion and redirection logic.

classes.name: NodeRevisionDeleteForm
classes.description: A form class for deleting a node revision in Drupal, extending ConfirmFormBase to handle confirmation and deletion logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing storage, access, and date formatter dependencies.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with dependencies from the container.

methods.name: getQuestion
methods.description: Returns the confirmation question with the revision date.

methods.name: getCancelUrl
methods.description: Provides URL to the node's version history page.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, setting the revision to delete.

methods.name: submitForm
methods.description: Handles the deletion of the revision, logging, messaging, and redirection.
